arista_environment_fan_up: Indicates whether the fan is operating normally (1) or not (0).
arista_environment_power_capacity: Displays the rated capacity of a power supply.
arista_environment_power_in: Displays the input power of a power supply.
arista_environment_power_out: Displays the output power of a power supply.
arista_environment_power_up: Indicates whether the power supply is operating normally (1) or not (0).
arista_environment_sensor_temp: Displays the current temperature reported by a switch temperature sensor.
arista_interface_admin_up: Indicates whether the interface is administratively enabled (1) or disabled (0).
arista_interface_crc_errors: Displays the number of CRC errors received on the interface.
arista_interface_receive_broadcast: Displays the number of inbound broadcast packets received on the interface.
arista_interface_receive_bytes: Displays the number of bytes received on the interface.
arista_interface_receive_drops: Displays the number of inbound packets dropped on the interface.
arista_interface_receive_errors: Displays the number of inbound errors on the interface.
arista_interface_receive_multicast: Displays the number of inbound multicast packets received on the interface.
arista_interface_transmit_bytes: Displays the number of bytes transmitted on the interface.
arista_interface_transmit_drops: Displays the number of outbound packets dropped on the interface.
arista_interface_transmit_errors: Displays the number of outbound errors on the interface.
arista_interface_up: Indicates whether the interface line protocol is up (1) or down (0).
arista_lldp_neighbor_labels: Displays link layer discovery protocol information about neighbors of the Arista switch.
arista_optic_rx: Displays the receive optical power (dBm) of the transceiver.
arista_optic_temperature: Displays the transceiver temperature in degrees Celsius.
arista_optic_tx: Displays the transmit optical power (dBm) of the transceiver.
arista_switch_labels: Displays identifying configuration detail of the Arista switch.
arista_switch_uptime: Displays uptime duration of the Arista switch.
